mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise in the current month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with housing starts above 1.2 million units, robust housing activity signals strong consumer demand and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1.2 million units
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1.2 million units, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates monetary tightening causing economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE rise in the current month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime with industrial production below 100, manufacturing weakness signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings cuts, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances during supply contraction (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
